messages.author: 7dd668eb41c5bfd9
messages.subject: Ecology papers using STAN
parts:
Hey everyone,

I wanted to let you all know that I used PySTAN throughout most of my dissertation, and continue to do so. I was going to wait until there was a good time to provide citations, but it seems like there isn't one. So here's what I have so far, although I have multiple papers in various stages of review and/or preparation also using PySTAN. These paper cover a variety of topics, including physiological ecology, global change, and community ecology.

Shantz, Lemoine et al. in Ecology Letters: http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/ele.12538/abstract
Lemoine et al. in Ecology http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1890/14-1883.1/full
Lemoine et al. in PeerJ https://peerj.com/articles/376/

Thanks for all of your hard work!

Nate
